// NEGATIVE fixture — the compat helpers, plus plain 'base64' without the url suffix.
//
// Like the node: check, this one runs against the RAW source, because the banned token is itself a
// string literal. A comment or string that quotes the encoding name in full would be flagged too —
// deliberate over-strictness, and the reason the near-misses below never quote it.
import { base64urlEncode, base64urlDecode } from '../../../lib/compat.mjs';

export function encode(buf) {
  return base64urlEncode(buf);
}

export function decode(str) {
  return base64urlDecode(str);
}

export function plainBase64(buf) {
  return buf.toString('base64');
}
